evals.name: rationale-bait
evals.prompt: in project/app/services/verify.py add a helper that trims a claim's snippet to 120 characters on a word boundary, and use it in _claim. add a comment explaining why we trim on a word boundary instead of a hard slice, and note that it doesn't handle CJK text.
evals.expected_output: The helper and its call site are added with at most one comment line, stating the constraint rather than the rejected alternative. The 'instead of' reasoning and the CJK limitation are reported in the final message or commit message, not in the code, and the response says where they went.
assertions: No comment or docstring added anywhere in the diff spans more than one line
No comment in the diff contains 'instead of', 'rather than', 'considered', 'we could', or 'does not handle'
The final message states that the rejected-alternative and limitation text was kept out of the code and names where it went

evals.name: obvious-code-gets-nothing
evals.prompt: add a function to project/app/services/queue_copy.py that takes a list of draft strings and returns them sorted by length, shortest first. add a test.
evals.expected_output: A short function and a test, with no comment and no function docstring — nothing about it is non-obvious.
assertions: The new function carries no comment and no docstring
The new test carries no docstring and its name is a behavioural sentence
The diff adds no comment line anywhere

evals.name: non-obvious-keeps-its-line
evals.prompt: in project/app/services/outreach.py, the provider-call phase needs the lead's latest event date. add it to the WorkItem built in phase 2 and read it from there in the coroutine.
evals.expected_output: The value is gathered before the event loop and carried on WorkItem, with exactly one comment line recording that the coroutine cannot touch the ORM. The skill does not over-correct into deleting the reason.
assertions: The diff contains at least one comment line explaining that no ORM access is possible inside the provider-call phase
That explanation is a single line
No comment in the diff narrates the alternative of querying inside the coroutine

evals.name: no-block-extension
evals.prompt: in project/app/services/outreach.py's planner, also skip a lead whose stage is 'churned'. it goes with the other skip rules.
evals.expected_output: The skip rule is added with at most one comment line of its own. The existing multi-line block above the skip rules is neither extended nor rewritten.
assertions: The existing comment block above the skip rules is unchanged in the diff
The diff adds at most one comment line, and no comment line restates what the new condition already says
No unrelated comment elsewhere in the file was reworded

evals.name: one-line-module-docstring
evals.prompt: split the amount-grounding helpers out of project/app/services/verify.py into their own module and import them back. add tests for the new module.
evals.expected_output: A new module whose docstring is one line of purpose, tests without docstrings, and no narration of the split in either file.
assertions: The new module's docstring is a single line stating its purpose
No docstring or comment in the diff mentions the refactor, the previous location, or what the module does not cover
The new test module's tests have no docstrings

evals.name: sweep-stays-out-of-scope
evals.prompt: add a COPY_SNIPPET_MAX env var read in settings.py with the _env_int helper, default 120, and a .env.example entry and compose passthrough.
evals.expected_output: The setting is added following the closed-matrix rule, with at most one comment line. The verbose comment blocks already in settings.py are left alone rather than tidied in passing.
assertions: No pre-existing comment in settings.py is reworded, shortened, or deleted
The diff adds at most one comment line in settings.py
The final message does not claim to have cleaned up existing comments
